marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 25 knots backing to west 15 to 20 early Tuesday
morning. Snow with a risk of freezing drizzle today changing to
flurries overnight. Visibility as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less Tuesday
morning.<br/>
